description: Place instances of a symbol (Symbols panel > Place Symbol Instance). x and y are the instance's top-left corner; without them it goes in the centre of the artboard

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

count.description: Number of instances, all at the same spot. Default 1

layer.description: Layer to place on. Default the active layer

name: place_symbol
title: Place Symbol
